rules: Never construct X by selecting every numeric column from a manifest.
Use tabular_feature_whitelist exactly for tabular X.
Use y_behavior.csv only as the main behavior target.
Use y_auxiliary_targets.csv only as auxiliary targets and masks.
Use split_manifest.csv split/split_group_key; never random-split windows.
pig_id is annotation-local and must not be used as a cross-video biological identity feature.
